title: 第20章 S级生存难度
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
法相境巅峰境界，已经是同龄人中第二梯队天才的层次。

    超一线梯队，无疑是唐梦宫这种举世罕见的天之骄女。

    一线梯队，各大顶级势力的传承圣子级别天才。

    二线梯队，则是一般大势力中的第一、第二真传弟子层次。

    此等天才，也已是凤毛麟角的存在。

    当然，大多达到这一步的天才，都是通过勤勤恳恳修炼而来，极少会使用丹药大幅度提升境界。

    一方面是提升境界的丹药价格太贵，另一方面则是担心副作用问题。

    以大夏神朝的底蕴，秦然能用到的天阶丹药也不过这两枚，足以显现这类丹药的惊人价值。

    至于副作用，那就更不用说了。

    级别越低的丹药，副作用越重，长期服药强行提升境界，只会将丹药中的垃圾残存在体内。

    长此以往，未来上限会被大大限制！

    “副作用的问题，都是天才们该考虑的，我现在可没有稳扎稳打提升境界的时间，况且这三枚丹药的级别足够高，副作用并不大……”

    这番提升境界依旧是在隐藏着进行，无人察觉。

    如今，青符虽然有了归顺的意向，但没真正控制住他的家人，秦然也不敢拿自己的命去赌。

    一些秘密还是自己知道为好。

    时间一分一秒的过去。

    很快，凌晨到来。

    【叮咚！】

    【今日生存挑战结束！】

    【完成度评估中……】

    【您顺利通过徐若晗的问心局，并获得对方高额好感度！】

    【最终评估，任务完成度150%。】

    【奖励已发放。】

    其实，昨天凌晨系统刚发布任务的时候，他就很疑惑。

    他搞不懂与徐若晗的相处，为什么系统会评分为A级。

    明明徐若晗是九个妃子当中最安全的那一个。

    但今日接触后，秦然知晓了原因。

    徐若晗没对他的身体造成伤害，但深情和真心却给他的心灵带来了巨大冲击。

    在那一刻，他对这些纸片人有了不一样的想法。

    系统说这是问心局，倒也不算有问题。

    通过今日与徐若晗的交流，他对这些纸片人的态度，对这个世界的态度，的确有了不小的改观……

    秦然正思索着今日会是什么奖励之时，忽然间，外面天空中响起一道悦耳的鼓瑟琴音。

    大夏皇宫上方的漆黑夜空，诡异的亮了起来。

    越来越亮，宛若白昼……
content_en:
At the peak of Dharma Realm, he is already the second-tier genius among his peers.

A super first-tier echelon, she is undoubtedly a rare and proud girl like Tang Menggong.

The first-tier echelon, the inherited saint son-level geniuses of all the top powers.

The second-tier echelon is the first and second true disciple levels among the general big forces.

Such geniuses are already rare.

Of course, most geniuses who have reached this stage have achieved this through diligent cultivation, and very few will use pills to significantly improve their realm.

On the one hand, pills for improving one's realm are too expensive, and on the other hand, they are worried about side effects.

With the foundation of the Great Xia Dynasty, Qin Ran could only use these two heaven-level elixirs, which was enough to show the amazing value of such elixirs.

Not to mention the side effects.

The lower the level of the elixir, the more serious the side effects. Taking the medicine for a long time to forcibly improve the realm will only leave the garbage in the elixir in the body.

If things continue like this, the upper limit will be greatly limited in the future!

"The issue of side effects is something that geniuses should consider. I don't have time to improve my level steadily now. Besides, the level of these three pills is high enough, and the side effects are not big..."

This level of improvement is still hidden and no one is aware of it.

Now, although Qing Fu has the intention to surrender, he has not really controlled his family, and Qin Ran does not dare to gamble with his own life.

It's better to keep some secrets to yourself.

Time passed by minute by minute.

Soon, morning comes.

[Ding dong!】

【Today’s survival challenge ends!】

[Completeness evaluation in progress...]

[You successfully passed Xu Ruohan's questioning game and gained a high amount of favorability from the other party!】

[Final evaluation, task completion is 150%.】

[Rewards have been distributed.】

In fact, when the system first released the task early yesterday morning, he was very confused.

He couldn't understand why the system rated him as A-level when getting along with Xu Ruohan.

Xu Ruohan is obviously the safest among the nine concubines.

But after contacting him today, Qin Ran knew the reason.

Xu Ruohan did not cause any harm to his body, but his deep affection and sincerity had a huge impact on his soul.

At that moment, he had a different idea about these paper figures.

The system said it was a matter of asking questions, but that was not a problem.

Through today's exchange with Xu Ruohan, his attitude towards these paper people and the world has indeed changed a lot...

When Qin Ran was thinking about what reward he would get today, suddenly, a pleasant sound of drums and harp sounded in the sky outside.

The dark night sky above the Daxia Imperial Palace lit up strangely.

It's getting brighter and brighter, like day...
